body.purpose: Setup, status, errors, and explanatory copy.

shadows.name: control-xs
shadows.purpose: Outline controls only when surface separation needs reinforcement.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, and compact state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact high-contrast action used for the primary operation in a local group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Familiar secondary action with a quiet border and tonal hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric Group
components.description: Provider heading followed by compact usage rows, with semantic incident state.
components.css: .ds-metric { width: 280px; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--foreground); font: 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric-head, .ds-metric-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-metric-head { margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 18px; } .ds-metric-head span { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-metric-row { margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-metric progress { width: 100%; height: 6px; accent-color: var(--primary); }

narrative.overview: A compact working instrument beside the user's editor and terminal. Legible values, familiar controls, calm state changes, and explicit provenance take priority over decorative dashboard styling.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent and semantic colors indicate selection, provider identity, progress, or system state. They are not decoration.

rules.name: The State-Only Elevation Rule
rules.body: Stronger elevation belongs to dialogs, popovers, and active drag state, never static dashboard decoration.

dos: Keep current usage and incident state visible before setup detail.
Respect reduced motion and use 150ms to 250ms state transitions.
Use text or icons in addition to semantic color.
donts: Do not use decorative SaaS dashboard treatments, oversized marketing metrics, glassmorphism, or gratuitous animation.
Do not create provider-specific interface forks when shared metric, account, or history patterns work.
Do not hide credential access, import scope, errors, or data provenance behind ambiguous labels.
